title: Native Windows full graph pulls POSIX-only tests into VIXEN capture builds
body: The queued native-build.sh --source-commit 3974cb94 and 07230277 builds each failed seven unrelated MSVC targets because test sources include unistd.h, even though the vixen_lookdev_capture target built and ran. Make POSIX-only tests conditional on their platform or make the capture target graph exclude them so a scoped native witness is not held red by unrelated portability tests.

title: VIXEN native capture readiness is all-or-nothing after a scoped target build
body: The full native graph red left no .vixendll-build-ready marker even after vixen_lookdev_capture compiled successfully, so the lane had to create the full-SHA readiness and identity marker files by hand before the documented capture runner would start. The runner/build contract should publish target-scoped readiness or report the dependency that actually blocks the selected capture.

title: WSL-to-cmd native target builds pass literal quote characters
body: A documented native target-build attempt through cmd.exe passed literal backslash-quote characters into the Windows command line and failed before CMake; the lane had to invoke the native CMake executable directly from the queued shell. Normalize the WSL/native command boundary so the documented target build works without hand-rewriting its quoting.

title: Native capture env wrapper turns normal shader INFO stderr into a fatal error
body: The documented native-capture.sh --env VIXEN_RECIPE_CHUNK_CULL=1 path failed in Invoke-CTestDirect because the shader builder writes ordinary INFO diagnostics to stderr and PowerShell raised NativeCommandError before the capture. The wrapper should preserve the child exit status and tolerate non-error stderr, allowing flag-on captures without bypassing the harness.

title: Capture queue replay can return stale artifacts for a fresh pixel witness
body: A fresh flag-off native-capture command was replayed by the queue and returned an earlier artifact; the lane had to set UT_QUEUE_REPLAY=0 before recapturing. Fresh-image witness labels should either disable replay automatically or expose the replayed artifact identity so a lane cannot mistake a cached run for a new measurement.
